_info: Tiempos verbales. Mismo formato que errors.json: cada tema tiene regla, explicación, ejemplos y ejercicios ('mc' u 'fill'). Los 'id' de ejercicios deben ser únicos.

topics.title: for · ago · since
topics.rule: for + duración · ago = hace tanto tiempo (con pasado simple) · since + punto de inicio (con present perfect).
topics.explanation: for three years (cuánto duró) · three years ago (cuándo pasó, mirando hacia atrás desde hoy) · since 2022 / since Monday / since I joined (desde cuándo, y sigue hasta hoy). «since» casi siempre va con present perfect: I've worked here since 2022.

examples.wrong: I've worked in customer service since three years.
examples.right: I've worked in customer service for three years.

options: I had this job since 2023 ago.

topics.title: Past Simple vs Present Perfect
topics.rule: Past Simple = acción terminada en un momento definido. Present Perfect = experiencia o resultado que importa ahora, sin momento definido.
topics.explanation: Past Simple con yesterday, last week, in 2023, «at Concentrix» (un trabajo que ya terminó): I handled 60 calls a day. Present Perfect con ever, never, already, yet, so far, this week (aún no termina), o for/since hasta hoy: I've worked with suppliers from five countries. Si decís CUÁNDO, va pasado simple.

examples.wrong: I have finished my degree in 2023.

options: I've used Salesforce for three years, and I still use it.

exercises.answer: I've used Salesforce for three years, and I still use it.

topics.title: will vs going to
topics.rule: going to = plan ya decidido o predicción con evidencia. will = decisión en el momento, ofrecimiento, promesa o predicción sin evidencia.
topics.explanation: Si lo decidís mientras hablás, «I'll»: I'll send it now / I'll check and get back to you. Si ya estaba planeado antes, «going to»: I'm going to visit the supplier next month. Con evidencia visible: Look at the queue — we're going to have a busy morning.

examples.wrong: Can you send the minutes? — Sure, I'm going to send them now.
examples.right: Can you send the minutes? — Sure, I'll send them now.

examples.wrong: I've booked my flight. I will visit the supplier next month.
examples.right: I've booked my flight. I'm going to visit the supplier next month.

options: I call the broker now, I promise.

topics.title: would para rutinas del pasado
topics.rule: would + verbo = acción que se repetía en el pasado. Para estados (be, have, live, like) usá «used to».
topics.explanation: Ideal para describir un día típico de un trabajo anterior: «Every morning I would open my systems, check the queue and take my first call at 7:15.» Suena natural y mantiene el pasado sin repetir «I did…, I did…». Pero con estados no: «I used to live in Heredia» (no «I would live»).

examples.wrong: Every morning I open Salesforce before my first call. (hablando de Concentrix)
examples.right: Every morning I would open Salesforce before my first call.

examples.wrong: I would live in Heredia when I worked there.
examples.right: I used to live in Heredia when I worked there.

exercises.prompt: At Concentrix, every morning I ___ open Salesforce and Genesys before my first call.

Estado, no acción: I ___ live in Heredia when I worked at Concentrix.
During my internship, I ___ check the status of every shipment in TICA each afternoon.

Estado, no acción: My old manager ___ have a very strict schedule.

¿Cuál describe bien una rutina pasada?
options: Every Friday, I would send the weekly report to the import manager.
Every Friday, I will send the weekly report to the import manager.
Every Friday, I would sent the weekly report to the import manager.
Every Friday, I'm sending the weekly report to the import manager.
exercises.answer: Every Friday, I would send the weekly report to the import manager.
